body:
I can repro and confirm that this is an issue. The reason for it is that collision queries in Jolt will return a hit with every triangle that a shape touches. `intersect_shape` doesn't return information about the triangle that was hit, so it will return multiple hits that look identical.

I've added a second shape to the MRP:
[intersect-shape-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28427356/intersect-shape-test.zip)
GodotPhysics returns 2 hits in that case (max 1 per shape), so this is probably what we want to implement for Jolt too.

The reason for this behavior is that the `intersect_shape` function uses this:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/dff2b9bb66a01d8c1a207531b0752405c7399124/modules/jolt_physics/spaces/jolt_physics_direct_space_state_3d.cpp#L581
This collector will need to be replaced with a collector that returns max 1 hit per leaf shape. Ideally it would also stop processing further hits for the shape to save CPU cycles. The best way to do this is a slightly larger change where we explicitly query the broadphase, for every returned `TransformedShape` collect the leaf shapes using `CollectTransformedShapes` and then for each leaf shape use a collector that collects 1 hit, earlies out when one has been found, and then passes it on to `JoltQueryCollectorAnyMulti`.
